title: PasteWare  Universal
features:
PasteWare is aimed as a universal script for all FPS shooters.

*Silent aim + bullet tp
* ACS weapon changer
* Cframe speed/fly
* target strafe 
* aimlock
* Good visuals
*Alot themes
*Full mobile support [fly soon bruh]


I try to make it visually pleasing and add interesting things

And I respect Averiias and give credit to his old creation

The script may have bugs now and there are conditional concessions for work everywhere. For example, hitsound works for any damage, even not from the player.

Someone might have already seen this script because I'm just adding it to scriptblox now
